chain.text:
**Estate:** 18 ha (11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc), clay/flint. ~62,000 bottles/yr; 2024 gave 48,000 after May hail destroyed ~20% of western plots.

**Certification:** Organic since 2019. Biodynamic conversion began 2023; needs three compliant years, so 2026 earliest.

**Sales:** Export 41%, mainly Belgium and Japan. Japanese importer requires sulphites under 60 mg/L.

**Failures:** 2022 tank 4 controller drifted 3°C for two days; batch lost aroma, sold in bulk, €11,000 loss. Fixed: controllers calibrated pre-harvest, tank 4 has second probe. 2023: 900 bottles wrong vintage shipped; all recalled. Fixed: label proofs need two signatures.

**Rules:** No irrigation on western plots (2021 trial lowered acidity below Japanese limit). Harvest dates set from sugar/acidity over three consecutive mornings, never calendar. Tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours.

**Open:** Lighter bottles proposed 2025; importer unconfirmed, no cost comparison. Eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided; vines 54 years old, yields down 30% in five years.
